This behavior, while involving network activity at runtime, is not part of the build or install process and thus falls under upstream application functionality, not a supply-chain risk.

There are no signs of obfuscated code, unauthorized downloads, or dangerous operations in this file. The use of `optdepends` to describe components fetched at runtime (e.g., umu-launcher, legendary) is clearly documented and expected for such a launcher application. No scripts or commands are present in this file that would execute malicious actions. The file contains no executable logic—only declarative packaging metadata—and aligns fully with safe, conventional AUR packaging.
